title: Decision Model Schema
description: Validates templates/<variant>/decisions/gates.yaml. Defines decision gates as part of the Domain Execution Graph (DEG). Each gate is a reusable decision point with decider, inputs, criteria, and outcomes. See design §9.2 and ADR-0083.

variant.description: Variant identifier matching the template directory name.

gates.description: List of decision gates in the variant's domain process.

id.description: Unique gate identifier. Pattern: DG- (gate prefix), variant letters/numbers, hyphen, two-digit number. Example: DG-CONSULT-01, DG-DECK-12.

title.description: Human-readable title of the gate (e.g. 'Diagnosis accepted').

stage.description: Stage identifier where this gate is applied. Resolves in process/stages.yaml. DEG-D-02 requires the stage to exist.

decider_agent.description: Kebab-case agent identifier that makes the decision at this gate. DEG-D-04 requires this to equal the stage's owner_agent.

inputs.description: Array of output_type references that are inputs to this gate (e.g. ['diagnosis_findings']). Each must exist in the variant's procedures/_output-types.yaml. DEG-D-06 enforces this.

criteria.description: Verifiable decision criteria. Each entry is a criterion statement that can be evaluated as pass/fail.

outcomes.description: Closed enumeration of possible outcomes (e.g. ['proceed', 'rework', 'stop']). DEG-D-03 requires at least two outcomes.

record_kind.description: Fixed value 'DEC'. Links gate definitions to decision records (docs/decisions/DEC-*.md) via ADR-0061.
